title: Epstein's gravity conference and submarine dives with Hawking in the Bahamas

related.note: Both describe Stephen Hawking going down in a submarine in the circle around Epstein. This telling says the dive was to look at possible Atlantis ruins, while the story says it was to study gravitational anomalies in the Bahamas basin.

plain: The claim is that the financier Jeffrey Epstein took people, including the physicist Stephen Hawking, down in submarines to study 'quantum gravitational anomalies' in the Bahamas basin, around the Bermuda Triangle. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, citing others, among them the researcher Eric Weinstein, and his own essay Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell, published July 29, 2025. Ghislaine Maxwell was Epstein's companion, and the essay says she 'piloted the "Atlantis" submarine' that took Epstein and Hawking 'down to the seabed of the Bermuda Triangle to study quantum magnetic anomalies.' That is one dive, and magnetic rather than gravitational, and the essay adds that Epstein's foundation sponsored a 2006 conference called 'Confronting Gravity' with top physicists from places like Caltech, MIT and Harvard, which would mean Epstein was funding secret anti-gravity research.

discussion.by: Ocean Outlaw: A Portrait of Ghislaine Maxwell
discussion.text: The piece names one submarine dive, in the Atlantis submarine Ghislaine Maxwell piloted, that took Epstein and Stephen Hawking "down to the seabed of the Bermuda Triangle to study quantum magnetic anomalies there", the region the podcast names; it tells one dive where the podcast speaks of people taken down in submarines, and it says magnetic where the podcast says gravitational.
